what: Trainer VM db paths and disk (MEASURED 2026-11-05 via trainer-vm-diag #23351, #23407, #23449, lane HF-LAKE-SQUASH). (1) With DATA_DIR/TRADE_JOURNAL_DB/TRAINER_STORE_DB all unset on the trainer (systemd Environment shows only ICT_BUILD_FUNDING_OI=1), src.utils.paths resolves trade_journal_db_path() to /home/ubuntu/ict-trading-bot/trade_journal.db, an 8,527,872 B file last written 2026-10-25 21:42 (a stray, 10 days stale), while the real nightly replica is data/trade_journal.db, 2,473,902,080 B, written 2026-11-05 08:02 (WAL mode). Anything on the trainer that reads the journal through the resolver without an explicit TRADE_JOURNAL_DB reads the stale file. trainer_store_db_path() resolves to /home/ubuntu/ict-trading-bot/trainer_store.db, which DOES NOT EXIST (no data/trainer_store.db either). Not verified: whether the trainer's scripts export TRADE_JOURNAL_DB themselves (sync_trainer_data.sh etc.), so this may be harmless; the question is which readers use the stray. Nothing deleted; the stray is evidence until the readers are known. (2) Trainer root disk 97 G, 85 G used, 13 G free (88%); data 25 G, datasets-out 12 G, ml 9.2 G account for 46 G, ~39 G of the used space is elsewhere and was not itemised. Headroom matters for sqlite .backup staging (2.5 G) and training outputs.
